# The Magick Muse

> The Magick Muse makes The Magick Manuscript, a living digital grimoire in Notion for witches and modern practitioners: 15 cross-linked witchcraft grimoires and 20,000+ pages of research, every entry sourced from published books by established authors and scholars. It also offers free witchcraft guides, two self-paced beginner courses, and a free Discord community.

Founded by Avelynn, a practitioner of over a decade and a teacher, whose practice centers on plant work, herbs, candles, tarot, runes, crystals, and protection magick. She handles the research; her husband handles the technical side.

## The Magick Manuscript (digital grimoire)

- [The Magick Manuscript](https://magickmuse.com/grimoires.html): a Notion-based digital grimoire. 15 grimoires: Animals, Astrology, Cards (tarot, oracle, lenormand), Correspondences, Dreams, Entities (deities and spirits), Materials, Minerals (crystals), Oils, Plants (herbs), Recipes, Rituals, Runes, Symbols, and Timing (moon phases, planetary hours). 20,000+ pages, 170+ guide pages, 8+ built-in widgets, 86+ journal prompts.
- Price: $333, one time, with every future update included. No Notion experience needed; Notion is free.
- Delivery: a Notion invite to the purchase email, usually within 24 hours. All sales final.
- Good for: beginners who want a trustworthy starting point without misinformation, and experienced practitioners who want sourced, cross-linked depth. Every entry is sourced from published books, and the Manuscript includes a full citation page.
- Buy: https://themagickmuse.gumroad.com/l/manuscript

## Blank grimoire templates (build your own)

- [Build your own](https://magickmuse.com/grimoires.html#build-your-own): blank Notion templates using the Manuscript's structure, for people who want to fill in their own research.
- The Blank Grimoire ($10+, pay what you can): blank versions of 14 of the Manuscript's grimoires. https://themagickmuse.gumroad.com/l/blankgrimoire
- Blank Crystal Grimoire (free): a blank Crystal grimoire template. https://themagickmuse.gumroad.com/l/freesample

## Courses

- [Witchcraft courses](https://magickmuse.com/mastery.html#courses): two self-paced beginner courses on Google Classroom, seven units each, with readings, key terms, practical application, a discussion prompt, and homework per unit. Pay what you can, starting at $10.
- Witchcraft 101 ($10+): what witchcraft is, tools and altars, correspondences, spiritual hygiene, shadow work, spell preparation, and casting a spell. https://themagickmuse.gumroad.com/l/witchcraft101
- Witchcraft 111 ($20+): divination, astrology, herbalism, ancestor veneration, deities, runes, and crystals. https://themagickmuse.gumroad.com/l/witchcraft111

## Community

- [Magick Muses](https://magickmuse.com/meetup.html): a free Discord community of 950+ practitioners, with grimoire discussion boards, a community spellbook, a book library, events, and 30+ channels. https://discord.com/invite/PBr2BtCpxk

## Free guides (blog)

- [Astrology for Witches: Timing Spells by Moon & Planets](https://magickmuse.com/astrology-for-witches.html): You don't need a birth chart to time a spell. The seven planets, moon phases, and moon signs, and how to layer them without obsessing.
- [Witch Tools for Beginners: What You Need & Your First Altar](https://magickmuse.com/essential-witch-tools-for-beginners.html): Forget the Pinterest altar. The handful of tools a new witch uses most, and how to set up a working altar in a whole room or a shoebox.
- [How to Celebrate Samhain: Rituals, Divination, and Ancestor Work](https://magickmuse.com/how-to-celebrate-samhain.html): Samhain is the witch's new year, when the veil grows thin. Learn its history, when to celebrate, and simple rituals for honoring your ancestors.
- [Can You Be a Witch Without Being Wiccan?](https://magickmuse.com/witch-without-wicca.html): Wicca is a religion. Witchcraft is a practice. Learn the difference, where the Threefold Law comes from, and how to find your own path as a witch.
- [Candle Magick for Beginners: Colors, Anointing, Fire Safety, and Reading the Flame](https://magickmuse.com/candle-magick-for-beginners.html): Candle magick is one of the simplest ways to start casting. Learn candle color meanings, how to anoint a candle, fire safety, and how to read the flame and wax.
- [Crystals for Beginner Witches](https://magickmuse.com/crystals-for-beginners.html): Amethyst, citrine, clear quartz, and five more starter stones, plus how to cleanse, charge, and spot fakes before they end up on your altar.
- [Herbalism for Witches: Working With Plants Safely](https://magickmuse.com/herbalism-for-witches.html): Rose petals for romance, bay leaves for luck. Plant magick is everywhere, and working with it safely starts with knowing your herbs.
- [Ten Years a Witch: What I'd Tell My Beginner Self](https://magickmuse.com/how-my-witchcraft-practice-has-changed.html): Over ten years of practice, a lot has shifted. What I've unlearned, what I trust now, and what I'd tell my beginner self if I could.
- [How to Cast a Spell: Candles, Jars, Sachets & Sigils](https://magickmuse.com/how-to-cast-a-spell-for-beginners.html): Candles, jars, sachets, and sigils each do something different. How to build each one, and why every spell starts with a clear intention.
- [How to Dispose of a Spell: Wax, Herbs & Spell Jars](https://magickmuse.com/how-to-dispose-of-a-spell.html): The candle burned out. Now what? Burying, burning, crossroads, running water, and the trash can, matched to the working they came from.
- [Witchcraft Misinformation: How to Find Reliable Sources](https://magickmuse.com/how-to-find-reliable-witchcraft-information.html): Black tourmaline protects, or it's dangerous, or it needs a full moon first. Sorting real knowledge from confident guesswork, one red flag at a time.
- [How to Research Witchcraft and Find Your Own Answers](https://magickmuse.com/how-to-research-witchcraft.html): Every book gives a different answer, and so does every website. Research is how a witch cuts through the noise, and anyone can build the skill.
- [Ancestor Work for Beginners: Honoring Your Lineage](https://magickmuse.com/how-to-work-with-ancestors-witchcraft.html): Your ancestors are the closest spirits you have. A simple altar, the right offerings, and a real relationship, even without a family tree.
- [Deity Work for Beginners: Approaching the Gods](https://magickmuse.com/how-to-work-with-deities-witchcraft.html): "Which deity is calling me?" is usually the wrong first question. Approaching gods with patience, research, and respect, and what silence can mean.
- [Working With the Greek Gods: Kharis & Offerings](https://magickmuse.com/how-to-work-with-greek-gods.html): Kharis is the heart of Hellenic worship: a relationship built on gifts, gratitude, and showing up. Meet the Olympians and start the right way.
- [The Law of Similars: Why Like Affects Like in Magick](https://magickmuse.com/law-of-similars-witchcraft.html): Why red for love and green for money? Meet the Law of Similars, the principle behind nearly every spell, and start reading your tools like a witch.
- [Meditation for Witches: A Beginner's Guide to Focus](https://magickmuse.com/meditation-for-witches-beginners.html): Meditation doesn't mean an empty mind. Five minutes of breath, a little time outside, and simple grounding can change how your spellwork feels.
- [Protection Magick for Beginners: Shields, Wards & Banishing](https://magickmuse.com/protection-magick-for-beginners.html): Before you manifest anything, protect what you have. Shields, wards, banishing, and the small daily habits that make a protection practice hold.
- [Runes for Beginners: How to Read the Elder Futhark](https://magickmuse.com/runes-for-beginners.html): Rune doesn't mean letter. It means secret. A grounded introduction to the Elder Futhark, from Odin's ordeal to your first three-rune spread.
- [What Is a Correspondence in Witchcraft?](https://magickmuse.com/what-is-a-correspondence-in-witchcraft.html): Black tourmaline for protection, Friday for love. A correspondence is energy shared between things, and it's the idea that holds spellwork together.
- [Divination for Beginners: Tarot, Runes & Signs](https://magickmuse.com/what-is-divination-witchcraft.html): Tarot is one tool in a much bigger box. Signs, runes, pendulums, scrying, and more, with a simple way to find the method that fits you.
- [Shadow Work for Witches: What It Is & How to Begin](https://magickmuse.com/what-is-shadow-work-witchcraft.html): You can't know anything else until you know yourself. Where shadow work comes from, how it shows up in your craft, and how to start gently.
- [Your First Tarot Deck: How to Choose, Cleanse & Read](https://magickmuse.com/what-to-do-with-your-first-tarot-deck.html): You don't have to be gifted your first deck. Choosing one, cleansing and bonding with it, and interviewing it before your first real reading.
- [What to Put in a Grimoire: A Look Inside Mine](https://magickmuse.com/what-to-include-in-a-grimoire.html): A grimoire and a Book of Shadows aren't the same thing. A tour of the sections inside The Magick Manuscript, and how to decide what goes in yours.
- [Best Witchcraft Books for Beginners: A Reading List](https://magickmuse.com/witchcraft-books-for-beginners.html): Some witchcraft books are excellent and some just have nice covers. A beginner reading list by topic, drawn from the shelf that built the Manuscript.
